_about: E. G. Hardy (d. 1925), Vice-Principal of Jesus College, Oxford, Roman historian, raw IA OCR: Pliny's letters to Trajan with notes and introductory essays (Macmillan; the OCR reads the year as '1989', IA dates it 1889); Juvenal, Thirteen Satires, edited for schools, second edition (Macmillan, 1893); Christianity and the Roman Government (Longmans, 1894); Jesus College, in the Oxford College Histories (F. E. Robinson, 1899); Studies in Roman History (Sonnenschein / Macmillan, 1906) and its second series (Sonnenschein, 1909); Six Roman Laws, translated with introduction and notes (Clarendon Press, 1911). His translation with J. S. Mann of Schomann's Antiquities of Greece (1880) is on the schomann shelf. Latin-dense commentaries kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dv). No uids minted.
